cards.claim: CIFAR-100 ResNet-56 achieves 75.0% accuracy in 50 epochs using 1cycle learning rate policy with LR range 0.1-0.5 and cyclical momentum 0.95-0.85, batch size 512
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-56 architecture, batch size 512, no TTA mentioned, 50 epochs

cards.claim: CIFAR-100 ResNet-56 at 25 epochs with 1cycle (0.1-0.5) learning rate exceeds accuracy of any step learning rate policy result at any epoch count
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-56, batch size 512, 1cycle policy vs step policy, 25 epochs
cards.effect: Faster convergence: 25 epochs with 1cycle beats all step-policy epoch counts
cards.quote: at only 25 epochs the accuracy is higher than any with a step learning rate policy

cards.claim: Large learning rates (0.1-4.0 range) reduce weight decay requirement and require reducing batch normalization momentum (0.9 to 0.85 cyclical) for optimal regularization balance on CIFAR-100 and other datasets
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100 and other datasets (Cifar-10, DenseNet), with super-convergence training
cards.effect: Enables faster training via regularization rebalance without accuracy loss
cards.evidence: Table 2, Section 5, and explicit discussion of regularization principle
cards.quote: reducing regularization in the form of weight decay when training... allows the use of larger learning rates and produces much faster convergence and higher final accuracies

cards.claim: Wider architectures (Wide ResNet) converge faster with 1cycle: 96.5% in 100 epochs versus 95.3% with standard step policy requiring 800 epochs
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10 Wide ResNet 32, batch size 512, LR range 0.1-1.0, 100 vs 800 epochs
cards.effect: 8x fewer epochs for comparable accuracy on wider networks
cards.evidence: Table 2 and text discussion of wide resnets
cards.quote: In 100 epochs, the wide32 network converges and provides a test accuracy of while the standard training method achieves an accuracy of only in 800 epochs

cards.claim: 1cycle policy with appropriately reduced weight decay enables ImageNet training to converge in 20 epochs (ResNet-50: 64.0% top-1) versus 100 epochs (65%) with standard step policy
cards.conditions: ImageNet, ResNet-50, reduced weight decay (7e-4 optimal), LR 0.05-1.0, batch size and momentum 0.9
cards.effect: 5x faster convergence with higher final accuracy
cards.quote: The red and yellow training curves in Figure 6(a) use the 1cycle learning rate schedule for 20 epochs... The final top-1 test accuracy in Figure 6(a) is 63.7% but the blue curve appears to be headed to an final accuracy near 65%
